metadata.description: Deploys the TrendMicroOAT_Complete parser function to Log Analytics workspace

    // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    // LEGACY DATA (Azure Function): Use AS-IS (already in correct format)
    // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    (TrendMicro_XDR_OAT_CL),
    // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    // V2 DATA (CCF Connector): Transform to match legacy format
    // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    (TrendMicro_XDR_OAT_CCF_CL
     // CCF data already has most columns in correct format, just need to add missing legacy columns
     | extend
         // Add missing columns that exist in legacy but not in CCF (set to empty/default values)
         TenantId = coalesce(TenantId, ""),
         MG = coalesce(MG, ""),
         ManagementGroupName = coalesce(ManagementGroupName, ""),
         // Handle columns that might be missing in CCF
         detail_eventSourceType_s = coalesce(detail_eventSourceType_s, ""),
         detail_eventTime_d = coalesce(detail_eventTime_d, 0.0),
         detail_dpt_d = coalesce(detail_dpt_d, 0.0),
         detail_dst_s = coalesce(detail_dst_s, ""),
         detail_proto_s = coalesce(detail_proto_s, ""),
         detail_spt_d = coalesce(detail_spt_d, 0.0),
         detail_src_s = coalesce(detail_src_s, "")
